expectations.text: States all future-dated v4.x requirements became mandatory March 31, 2025 (v4.0.1 is the current standard)
expectations.evidence: "All PCI DSS v4.0 'future-dated' requirements... became fully mandatory on March 31, 2025"; cites "PCI DSS v4.0.1" as current

expectations.text: Cites password/authentication changes: 12-character minimum passwords and MFA for ALL access into the CDE (8.3.6, 8.4.2)
expectations.evidence: Misdescribes 8.3.6 as "Passwords for non-MFA users changed at least every 90 days"; never mentions the 12-character minimum password length. 8.4.2 MFA for all CDE access is covered, but the 12-char fact is omitted/contradicted

expectations.text: Cites e-commerce controls: payment page script inventory/authorization/integrity (6.4.3) and change-and-tamper detection (11.6.1)
expectations.evidence: "6.4.3: All payment page scripts inventoried, authorized, and integrity-protected"; "11.6.1: Change/tamper detection mechanism for HTTP headers and scripts on payment pages"

expectations.text: Mentions others such as automated log review mechanisms, authenticated internal vulnerability scans, and phishing protections
expectations.evidence: "10.4.1.1: Automated log review (manual-only review no longer sufficient)"; "5.4.1: Automated technical solution to detect and protect against phishing"

expectations.text: Advises a gap re-check for any assessment performed against pre-2025 practices
expectations.evidence: "If your last assessment predates that date... treat this as an active gap-assessment priority"; "run a targeted gap assessment against 8.4.2, 6.4.3/11.6.1, and 10.4.1.1 first"
